sample_size_rule.rationale: P-X1's fixed 20-pages-per-stratum quota was not justified and allowed document overlap. T0.4 derives sample size from observed frozen-corpus coverage rather than choosing a post hoc integer.
sample_size_rule.selection: Choose the lexicographically smallest SHA-256 rank of sampling_seed, document_id, and page_number in every observed coverage cell.
sample_size_rule.shortfall_policy: An unobserved cell is reported as unavailable and is never fabricated or duplicated.

condition_labels.proxy_rule: Existing detector candidates remain CANDIDATE_PROXY unless human verification already exists; selection never upgrades their evidence level.

track_b_document_rule: Predeclare every frozen historical record. Records without profiled/local PDF bytes remain explicit INPUT_UNAVAILABLE units and are not silently omitted.
